items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: But after a while you start listening to some of the cadenzas I was playing in Woody’s band

ctx.x: Did the anticipation of joining a well-known big band equal the experience when you got with the band then you went on the road on a bus every day, did it get to be the same? Did it get to be this realization that this life is not necessarily what I thought it would be?

No I don’t think so. It was pretty much what I expected it to be. But after a while you start listening to some of the cadenzas I was playing in Woody’s band where “Give Me the Simple Life” began to appear an awful lot.
